diff --git a/src/Core/Models/FeatureFlag.cs b/src/Core/Models/FeatureFlag.cs
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b2c3d4e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/Core/Models/FeatureFlag.cs
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+using System;
+using System.Collections.Generic;
+using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
+
+namespace Contoso.Store.Core.Models
+{
+    /// <summary>
+    /// Represents a feature flag definition stored in the database.
+    ///
+    /// Rollout strategies:
+    ///   Global  — flag applies to all users (UserPercentage and AllowedUserIds ignored)
+    ///   Percentage — flag applies to a deterministic subset of users (hash-based)
+    ///   Allowlist  — flag applies only to users listed in AllowedUserIds
+    ///
+    /// Flags are cached in-process for 60 seconds to avoid a DB round-trip on
+    /// every request to GET /api/featureflag/active.
+    /// </summary>
+    public class FeatureFlag
+    {
+        [Key]
+        [MaxLength(100)]
+        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
+
+        /// <summary>Human-readable description shown in the admin UI.</summary>
+        [MaxLength(500)]
+        public string? Description { get; set; }
+
+        /// <summary>Master switch. When false the flag is inactive for everyone.</summary>
+        public bool Enabled { get; set; }
+
+        /// <summary>Rollout strategy: "global", "percentage", or "allowlist".</summary>
+        [MaxLength(20)]
+        public string Strategy { get; set; } = "global";
+
+        /// <summary>
+        /// For Strategy="percentage": 0-100 percentage of users to enable.
+        /// Evaluated deterministically using hash(userId + flagName) % 100.
+        /// </summary>
+        public int? UserPercentage { get; set; }
+
+        /// <summary>For Strategy="allowlist": comma-separated user IDs or "*" for all.</summary>
+        public string? AllowedUserIds { get; set; }
+
+        public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
+        public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
+    }
+}
